mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, it is a clear 59 degrees near Reddan Soccer Park. We are under a First Quarter moon, and if you are up early, the International Space Station will be visible starting at 4:55 AM, moving from the Southwest over Mount Horeb toward the East Northeast in the direction of Fitchburg and Madison.

Construction is active in Verona with Phase 2 of the Mark Drive reconstruction currently underway, involving underground utility work between Nine Mound Road and Todd Street. Additionally, the city is prioritizing a connected active transportation network by adding sidewalks and multi-use paths to ensure safer travel for all residents.

There is plenty to do in town today, including Live Music at Paddy Mac's, UGM at Epic Systems, Yoga at Insight Wellness, the Downtown Farmer's Market, Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead to tomorrow, check out Concerts in the Park at Century School Park or trivia at Hop Haus Brewing.
On Friday, August 15, a 44-year-old woman was arrested for her first O W I offence after officers found her passed out behind the wheel near North Main Street and Cross Country Road.
You can enjoy the delicious Double Strawberry flavor today. Since the store is currently closed, head over when they open at 10 AM. If you miss out, tomorrow's flavor will be Chocolate Heath Crunch.
